_about: Where HullGrade's placed looks go on each hull, by hand, because finding them in the pixels put them anywhere (Jon, Oct 14: running lights 'random and bad', markings 'the execution is bad', the plate behind the number 'looks bad'). Keyed by the hull's path under art/sprites/hulls/ without .png; coordinates in that picture's own pixels (the full-size file). registry: the top-left of the 3x5 stencilled number, painted straight on a plain panel, and ink 'light' or 'dark' for what reads on that panel. chevrons: the tip of the first S-grade chevron on the nose, [x, y]. windows: [x, y, w, h] panes, aft to fore -- the hull's own dark glass where it has some; a fifth element 'glass' lights only the dark pixels inside the box, for a pane that is not a rectangle (a sloped canopy). nav: [x, y, 'white' | 'amber' | 'beacon'], the top-left of a 2x2 light; a beacon (the masthead) shows at S only, the one grade whose masts are whole. markers: [x, y, 'white' | 'amber', 'hull' | 'tip'] single-pixel surface lights, like an aircraft's: on the hull they light at A and S; on the tip of an antenna or mast (which the kit trims below S) at S only.
